W.note: A single blurred halo fades in on a slow expo-out after an overshoot lift, which reads clearly in the hover strip and stays legible, but the effect is restrained and closer to a soft glow than ethereal, with clean reduced-motion, focus ring and sold-out handling.

X.note: The richest dream vocabulary (aura bloom, drifting sheen, rising sparks, sliding aurora gradient) with a live curve and duration panel and a calm mode, though the sheen snaps back after a one second delay and the single 600ms expo curve is generic.

Y.note: The pastel gradient and rotating conic aura feel dreamy at rest, but in the hover strip the change is barely visible, the 900ms symmetric timing feels sluggish, and the blur and box-shadow transitions are heavier to render.

Z.note: Named curve tokens give a mild overshoot lift in and a calm exit with a drifting halo on an opacity-only layer, plus focus ring, reduced-motion path and disabled state, though the white halo on the soft button is nearly invisible and the dreamlike quality is more modest.
